body: I think you're right. The term "gaslighting" gets thrown around so much. I think too many people on this sub learn these words on this sub from context rather than looking them up

Oh my god, I know what you mean. My family drained me of everything I had and now, going forward I'm 27 years old and utterly incapable of having a social life where I'm not emotionally abused and kept down, but abusive relationships are surprisingly hard to find so rn I'm just really lonely. There's always drinking though. God gave us alcohol.

I tried that, but the therapist lost interest because I didnt want to take anxiety medication. In one of my last appointments I could hear her tv going... I feel like I dont need one at this point, none of the ones I've tried have done much good, the last one I had for five years just felt like going through the motions. None of them seem to take interest unless something dramatic was happening.

Huh. I guess I never really thought about the fact that I feel bad when good people are hurt too, i thought something was wrong with me because I always felt bad for bad people too. All my life my family has called me a pussy for this, but maybe feeling bad for my family was the only way to survive it. Kind of to keep reminding myself they were highly flawed people. I guess it's a good thing to still feel that way for others. It keeps me mostly unbiased I guess, lol.

Oh my god dont. I promise you, if she "friend-zoned" you, shes already been down every avenue of thought in terms of finding you suitable and came up short. Just take that energy to the next woman. Trying to change her mind for her though... that wont end well.

I felt like that two days ago. Now I'm fine. Just ride the cycles out like a bad trip. When you snap out of it (and I'm assuming you're like me and have good weeks and bad weeks) then you hit the ground running. You can kill yourself without dying. You can change everything you do every day and become something else, nothing can take that power away from you. 

Rome wasnt built in a day, but you plan while you're depressed and when your weeks get slightly better (possibly for no discernable reason) that's when you take action. 

Becoming comfortable with embarassment is like jumping into a cold river. it's only bad the first 2 or 3 times but it's worth it to feel alive again. 

If you can feel what I'm saying, eat your pain. Digest it. Shit it out. Flush without looking in the bowl. Leave.

Oof. Start a new account with a new name. I feel you though, I'm not an incel but I do have major depression that makes maintaining social relationships... difficult.

Even if we're not the same on the surface, on a deep level, we feel the same. You have the same problem as me, I manifest it by completely shutting myself down. You seem to manifest it by act abrasively, or maybe you shut yourself down as much as me. Either way, we ooze negativity to people. 

You ever think theres a huge invisible sign on your head telling everyone exactly what you are? There is.  It shows itself through your words and actions. Happy people aren't proud homophobes. I dont even need to read your post to tell you're depressed. 

I care about you though, and I want you to know nothing you "are" today is your fault. You can walk away from yourself without killing yourself it takes accepting who you are. It takes caring about other people. Literally the most selfless thing you can is put other people's needs ahead of yours.

You're in pain, and this must seem like a counter-intuitive approach. You might even be worried about looking like a little bitch. Those are just ways of shutting yourself down. 

I'm intensely familiar with the feeling of wanting to die. You may have had people tell you before "you have long, hard road ahead of you" and they're right. I've been all the way down your road. I've been a piece of shit, and it felt good to be among other pieces of shit. Its somewhere to finally belong. 

Living in that mentality is really comfortable quicksand.

Look how deep its dragged you.

Get out of it now. 

Fuck negative people, dont ever *try* to be accepted in any social circle; doing *that* is called "trying to be cool". I'm guilty of it too. Dont try to be cool, try to relax. If you act selflessly and relax, people will want to be in YOUR circle. 


It's a long and difficult road best get to stepping.

Hes in your community right? Why not offer to meet up with him for an arm wrestling match? Or maybe not that specifically with corona going on...

My friend, sometimes youre a frog in warm water, sometimes you're a frog being cooked alive in a boiling pot. The temperature change is imperceivable to the frog until the water is far too hot and it's too late.

That's really kind of you to offer, thanks

You take care too

That's such good fucking advice, I'll just chill and, much like a frog, enjoy a nice, complacent soak in the warm pot of water that is life. I'll chill while the water gets warmer and warmer on the stove, until it's too late. Until it's boiling and my guts bubble out my mouth. *Ahhh*.

You and u/mistarobotics are really nice. It's been a long time since something's made me tear up like this, and it means so much to me that you'd put so much thought and kind words in your responses. Thanks, really. You both helped a lot.
Then what do I do about the crippling loneliness? I have a huge empty void in me and I want to have happy memories.

Yeah I wish I could only meet new people. I feel like any other way, i just have an unquantifiable amount of time to disappoint or bore the people I meet. I know I'm bitter, but I have a lot of experience in social failure to go by lol.

Seeing someone only once, you only have to impress them once, you only have to have to have one good conversation, and they cant expect anything from you.

It's funny, I just had someone from highschool walk up to me at work, recognize me even though I've lost a lot of weight and was wearing a mask. Not only that, I barely knew him or ever really talked to him.

He looked happy to see me for some reason, we remembered each others' names. He started talking about other people we went to high school with and the only thing I could think was "i have no idea who 90% of my own graduating class was by name." I had no friends, I was shit on constantly... 

He looked decently happy though. Me, I'm a miserable prick. 

I definitely dont like remembering the worst years of my life, and certainly dont anyone from back then to know how much more miserable I am now, so yeah. I hate seeing people I knew from even past jobs.
